summary.zh: 本次更新修复了动态列表里推送事件点击无法打开 commit 详情的问题。
summary.en: Push events in the activity list now open the corresponding commit detail when tapped.

items.zh: 动态列表的推送事件点击现在会跳转到对应 commit 详情页，不再只能进仓库
items.en: Tapping a push event now opens the commit detail page instead of only the repository

items.zh: 推送事件卡片重新显示推送分支名（GitHub 接口已不再返回 commit 内容）
items.en: Push event cards show the pushed branch name again (GitHub no longer returns commit contents on events)
